Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper presents original research focused on predicting future land use and land cover (LULC) change across the entire national territory of Brazil until 2050. It explicitly implements three spatially explicit future scenarios—SSP1/RCP1.9, SSP2/RCP4.5, and SSP3/RCP7.0—with quantitative comparison of projected changes across six LULC classes. The modeling uses the LuccME framework combined with INLAND to incorporate biophysical, socioeconomic, and institutional drivers at a 10 km × 10 km resolution. Model performance is validated using quantitative metrics (e.g., spatial fit index of 84.44%, omission/commission errors), and outputs include gridded maps of projected LULC distributions. All core inclusion criteria are met: national-scale coverage, primary focus on LULC prediction, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatially explicit modeling with accuracy metrics, and mapped projections. No exclusion criteria apply.)
